_comment: Pinned canonical values verified by scripts/pull-canonical.mjs against the LIVE sources on every CI run. These are the load-bearing, stable fields (versions + tool counts) — NOT a byte-for-byte snapshot, so volatile fields like the manifest 'updated' date never cause a false drift. When the live API/discovery legitimately changes, bump the value here (and regenerate collections/vectors if the OpenAPI moved) in the same commit that refreshes discovery/agent.json + discovery/llms.txt. The MCP counts are a hosted number and a local number because @depixapp/mcp is one server at two levels: mcp_tool_count (26) is what the DePix App-hosted endpoint exposes, mcp_tool_count_full (58) is what the operator-run npx deployment exposes, and the local surplus splits into mcp_tool_count_wallet (29, the wallet_* tools) and mcp_tool_count_local (3, the agent-local register_account/agent_status/verify_domain tools) — both existing only where the local entry runs.
